question: Find Small Cell Lung trials with minimum follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves all Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC) trials from the database, ordering them by the overall follow-up duration in ascending order, with nulls last. It also displays the follow up duration for each arm.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\",\n\"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%SCLC%'\nORDER BY \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" ASC NULLS LAST",
  "answer": "This query retrieves all Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC) trials from the database, ordering them by the overall follow-up duration in ascending order, with nulls last. It also displays the follow up duration for each arm.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
